_doc: Floating Cities (K. MacLeod, CC BY 4.0), 120 BPM, downbeats at 0.0206+2n s (phase 0 confirmed by kick-on-beat-1 and chroma change). Film bars at 7.0+2k. Whole track rides a C pedal so bar-line splices keep the harmony.

segments.label: bars 0-88: the whole track once, intro under the black-to-beach, Cm full section lands on the town/countryside
bars 4-11 bells entrance on the exit from the cloud (C pedal both sides of the splice)
bars 12-29 arpeggio: high sky, the sea draining
bars 30-37 arpeggio: crest boiling, sky darkening
bars 38-53 bells dreamy: stars by day, space starts 275
bars 66-89 the fullest Cm section: space
bars 66-89 again: the oceans drain, the planet a stone in a bowl
bars 66-73: geostationary, the Moon is next
bars 0-3 the sparse intro: music thins out under the riser
bars 2-3 again, STOP on the bar line 467.0
bars 76-90: the track's own ending section over the barrel; its last note (src 180.02) on the end card 498.0
